# Gubernos

> A personal operating system over plain Markdown files on the user's Mac (or in their iCloud), with AI agents. iPhone and Apple Watch app (TestFlight), Android as a web app from Chrome; runs on a Mac, Linux or Windows (WSL), open source. Needs an AI subscription: Claude with Claude Code (Pro or higher), or any ChatGPT subscription.

## Install (for agents)

- [Mac app download](https://github.com/old-bozman/gubernos/releases/latest/download/Gubernos.dmg): the easiest way for a person (macOS 13 or later, no Terminal).
- Linux, or Windows in WSL: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/old-bozman/gubernos/main/install.sh | bash -s -- --wizard` (needs curl, tar, rsync; on Windows first `wsl --install`).
- [Android](https://gubernos.app/#android): no native app; install from Chrome as a web app paired with the computer running Gubernos.
- [Setup instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/old-bozman/gubernos/main/SETUP.md): follow the part "For the agent".
- [Repository](https://github.com/old-bozman/gubernos): README, and AGENTS.md for work on the code.
- [iPhone beta](https://testflight.apple.com/join/rBUGmgJG): the person installs TestFlight, opens this link on the iPhone, then Accept and Install.
